headline: Petron, Jetti Cut Diesel by ₱7.60 per Liter on September 29
seoTitle: Petron, Jetti Cut Diesel by ₱7.60/L on September 29 | FMB News
seoDescription: Petron and Jetti announced a ₱7.60-per-liter diesel rollback and a ₱0.30 gasoline cut effective Tuesday, September 29, 2026.
deck: Petron and Jetti announced a ₱7.60-per-liter diesel rollback and a ₱0.30 gasoline cut effective Tuesday, slightly beyond the Energy Department’s earlier estimates.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Petron Corporation and Jetti Petroleum announced Monday night that they will reduce diesel prices by ₱7.60 per liter and gasoline prices by ₱0.30 per liter effective Tuesday, September 29, according to the Philippine News Agency.

The company-announced figures are final advertised adjustments for those two firms. They are slightly larger than the Department of Energy’s earlier projections of a ₱7.57-per-liter diesel decrease and a ₱0.24 gasoline decrease, as reported by ABS-CBN News.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The Energy Department also projected a ₱5.85-per-liter decline in kerosene. That figure was an estimate issued before the companies’ final advisories; pump-price changes can vary by company and product.

This is a separate weekly adjustment from the Civil Aeronautics Board’s Level 17 airline fuel-surcharge ceiling for October 1–15. A pump-price rollback does not automatically change the aviation surcharge already set for that period.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The diesel cut is substantial for jeepney and bus operators, delivery fleets, farmers using diesel equipment, and households exposed to transport and logistics costs. The smaller gasoline reduction offers more limited relief to motorists.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Consumers should check the posted adjustment of their chosen fuel brand because final gasoline, diesel and kerosene reductions may differ slightly across companies. Other firms may issue or implement their own advisories on Tuesday.

verificationNotes: PNA's September 28 latest-news listing and official social post identify the late company-announced rollback and name Jetti Petroleum and Petron Corporation.
PNA reports final advertised cuts of ₱7.60 per liter for diesel and ₱0.30 per liter for gasoline for the two named firms, effective Tuesday.

ABS-CBN independently reports the DOE's earlier estimates of ₱7.57 for diesel, ₱0.24 for gasoline and ₱5.85 for kerosene; the article labels these as projections and does not present them as final company figures.
Kerosene and other companies' final advertised rates were not uniformly confirmed in the reviewed late advisories and are left unresolved.
The available event-specific press imagery did not carry sufficiently clear reusable-rights documentation; FMB's owned editorial fallback is used and explicitly labeled non-documentary.
